title: Parallel-bundle merge no longer pops — E1 'pop bigger' feedback silently dropped in the FlowView rewrite
evidence:
-		entry.arc.build(a.global_position, b.global_position, params[0], params[1])
-		_pop(entry.arc)
-		return entry.arc
...
+func _rebuild_view(id: int, p: Dictionary) -> void:
+	var arc: PipeArc = _pipe_views[id]
+	_apply_build(arc, p)
+	_pipe_meta[id] = {"parallel": int(p.parallel), "alloc": p.alloc.duplicate()}
...
+	_apply_build(arc, p)
+	_pop(arc)
detail: E1 popped the bundle on every parallel re-commit; the rewrite only pops on first creation (_create_view). Parallel merges now rebuild silently with no tactile feedback — an E1 affordance dropped without mention.
recommended_fix: Call _pop(arc) from _rebuild_view when parallel increases (or after flow_view.sync() in request_connect's merge path) to restore the pop-bigger beat.

title: Runtime composition root references editor-only EditorInterface under @tool — exported builds cannot parse main.gd
evidence:
+@tool
 extends Node3D
...
+	var vp3d := EditorInterface.get_editor_viewport_3d(0)
...
 [ext_resource type="Script" path="res://scripts/main.gd" id="1"]
detail: main.gd is the runtime scene root (main.tscn id=1) and now references EditorInterface, registered only in the editor binary. Exported builds cannot resolve the identifier; the script fails to load.
recommended_fix: Move the editor-preview capture into an editor-only utility script or EditorPlugin; keep EditorInterface references out of the runtime composition root.

title: sim_core header claims work-conserving lane cascade, but unspendable allowance is banked, not lent downward
evidence:
+## - E2.3 class lanes: per-bundle 3-lane allocation + per-class lane
+##   assignment; admission serializes Express -> Standard -> Best-effort,
+##   work-conserving (unused higher-lane allowance flows down), reserves hold
+##   under saturation, contention drops lowest drop-precedence first.
...
+				var used := 0
+				while not q.is_empty():
+					var milli := int(SimBalance.PACKET_MILLI[packets[q[0]].cls])
+					if used + milli > allowance:
+						break
...
+				p.credit[endpoint][lane] = allowance - used
+				# surplus a lane could not spend stays banked in its credit —
+				# it never skips the ladder (no flow UP)
detail: Class docstring promises unused higher-lane allowance flows down; code cascades only when a lane's queue is EMPTY. A busy lane whose packets exceed its allowance banks surplus — link capacity idles despite downstream demand.
recommended_fix: Either carry unspendable allowance down the ladder after the while-loop breaks, or correct the header: reserves are not work-conserving within a tick.

title: SimBalance.BASE_TRAVEL_U_S is unreferenced and documents a 'lane multiplier' mechanism that does not exist
evidence:
+const LANE_SPEED_MILLI := [200, 100, 60] # travel milli-units per tick, by lane (speed = priority)
...
+const QUEUE_DEPTH := 6 # waiting packets per (pipe endpoint, lane)
+const BASE_TRAVEL_U_S := 6.0 # nominal traversal speed at lane multiplier 1.0
detail: BASE_TRAVEL_U_S is declared but never referenced in this chunk; its comment names a 'lane multiplier 1.0' mechanism that doesn't exist — traversal uses absolute LANE_SPEED_MILLI. Stale tuning knob invites misuse.
recommended_fix: Delete BASE_TRAVEL_U_S, or derive LANE_SPEED_MILLI from it so the documented multiplier mechanism is real.

title: determinism_log.gd uses FileAccess.open result unchecked — null crash on missing captures/ dir
evidence:
+	var f := FileAccess.open("res://captures/05-replay-determinism.txt", FileAccess.WRITE)
+	f.store_string("\n".join(lines) + "\n")
...
+	var err := img.save_png(ProjectSettings.globalize_path("res://captures/08-editor-preview.png"))
+	print("editor-preview-shot: saved (err %d)" % err)
detail: FileAccess.open result is used unchecked; a missing captures/ directory yields null and the tool crashes on store_string, while _editor_preview_shot checks and reports its save error.
recommended_fix: Null-check f (and ensure captures/ exists) before writing; mirror the error reporting used by _editor_preview_shot.

title: Seeded world layout computed twice in _ready — staged nodes and sim placements can silently drift apart
evidence:
+	_generate_world()
+	sim = SimCore.new()
+	sim.setup(SEED, WorldSeed.node_placements(SEED, WorldSeed.wedge_layout(SEED)))
...
+func _generate_world() -> void:
+	_aim_lights()
+	var layout := WorldSeed.wedge_layout(SEED)
detail: _ready builds the world from wedge_layout(SEED), then independently recomputes node_placements(SEED, wedge_layout(SEED)) for the sim — the seeded layout is generated twice; the call sites can silently drift.
recommended_fix: Compute the layout (and placements) once in _ready and pass the same data to both _generate_world and sim.setup.
